title: WEXP × EMILIA INTEROP-002 — historical INTEROP-002 result
summary: Historical INTEROP-002 result from Publication Candidate 003: the frozen bridge was sufficient on seven frozen cases, while the joint WEXP × EMILIA comparison was inconclusive or not derived. The two scopes are kept separate; the package replays archived evidence without a new implementation run.

artifact.role: Publication Candidate 003 archive container, selected by content digest (RFC 6920 named-information URI). It has no public carrier yet; the URI identifies bytes, not a location.

payload.mode_note: All 57 archive members record permissions 0644 with no Unix file-type bit and the ZIP has no directory entries; Git represents every file as 100644 and directories are implicit. ZIP order, timestamps and extra fields remain in the ZIP.

independence.scope: No separate external reproduction of this complete package is claimed. Within the historical experiment, case B-01 was committed by the EMILIA-side contributor by SHA-256 before the bridge was authored, and the contributor reviewed the final record for fairness (PASS_WITH_PRECISIONS); the candidate records counterparty exact-byte review as not yet performed.
independence.method: Historical commitment, reveal and fairness-review records retained byte-for-byte; current migration verification is performed in the publisher-controlled preparation environment.

result.label: Historical INTEROP-002 result — split verdict: bridge sufficiency SUPPORTED; joint comparison INCONCLUSIVE (5/7), NOT_DERIVED (2/7)
result.details: WEXP bridge sufficiency: SUPPORTED for this bridge over these seven frozen cases. Joint WEXP × EMILIA comparison: INCONCLUSIVE for H-01-b, H-01-c, H-02, H-03 and B-01, which lack a native EMILIA output; NOT_DERIVED_UNDER_THIS_ORDER for C-00 and H-01-a. The record states that these MUST NOT be collapsed into a single verdict. Local minimality NOT_ESTABLISHED (15/17).

scopes.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE for every case lacking native EMILIA output

limitations: This package migration does not rerun any WEXP, EMILIA or bridge implementation and executes no archived code; the historical execution status EXECUTED remains only in payload/execution/EXECUTION-RECORD-001.json.
The two scopes of the historical result are separate claims and are not collapsed into one verdict; the comparison status split-verdict only points to the record that holds them.
Candidate 003 is a publication candidate: its own records state publication_authorized false and that counterparty exact-byte review was not yet performed. Those historical bytes are unchanged.

The selected ZIP is authoritative for archive composition; payload is its verified file-byte extraction, not the container bytes. The ZIP has no directory entries and its member modes carry no file-type bit.
